broker.name: XM
broker.tagline: Its site names FSC (Belize) and CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: The XM pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard, Ultra Low, and Shares. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and MT5 WebTrader. The site names these regulators: FSC (Belize) and CySEC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

regulators.entity: Trading Point of Financial Instruments Ltd

broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSC (Belize): XM Global Limited, 8557558. CySEC: Trading Point of Financial Instruments Ltd, 120/10.

leverage.note: Margin and leverage page says leverage remains up to 1000:1, including during volatility and NFP. Clients can adjust leverage.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Varies by account. The account-types page states a $5 minimum deposit for the Standard account and the Ultra Low account, and $10,000 for the Shares account. It also says that if the deposit currency is not USD, the amount shown is the equivalent in the deposit currency.

other_fees.label: Spreads

other_fees.value: Pay no swap fees and zero commission
other_fees.note: Homepage wording. The Ultra Low account page separately refers to lower swap fees and commissions, so this homepage line is not a full fee schedule.

other_fees.label: Withdrawals
other_fees.note: Why-trust-us page says instant withdrawals, 24/7, without any fees.
